result.inversion: Traditional memory consolidation processes are not lineage-safe, leading to unpredictable degradation, corruption, or instability in memory retention over time.
predictions: Experiments will show significantly higher memory retention rates in systems using lineage-safe consolidation compared to traditional methods.
Neural activity patterns (in biological systems) or computational models (in AI) will exhibit measurable instability when using non-lineage-safe consolidation techniques.
Error rates in memory recall tasks will increase exponentially with repeated iterations in non-lineage-safe consolidation frameworks.
